$description: Amber Monochrome Theme - P3 phosphor amber terminal aesthetic

error.$description: DMNC-1059: amber-mono is the DEFAULT theme — functional roles must NOT leak the honest :root red/green. Destructive fill uses dark amberDim so the white foreground keeps contrast (honest #AA0000 fill only appears under colour themes, e.g. cga-amber / the Modern theme DMNC-1058).

success.$description: DMNC-1059: amber-mono default — success text is amber (mirrors status.success), not honest green. Honest green resolves only under colour themes.

error.$description: DMNC-1059: amber-mono default — error text is amber (mirrors status.error), not honest red.

success.$description: DMNC-1059: amber-mono default — success border is amber, not honest green.

error.$description: DMNC-1059: amber-mono default — error/destructive border is amber, not honest red.

info.$description: DMNC-1059: info stays amber-family under amber-mono — in this palette `lightGray` resolves to the warm tan-amber #B87C1A (not a true gray; gray only appears under colour themes), which is readable on the dark CRT bg (~5.9:1, passes AA) and distinct from success(amberBright)/warning(yellow)/error(amber). Honest cyan under colour themes.

error.$description: DMNC-1059: destructive hover-glow is amber under the default amber-mono theme (not red).
